_about: Checked on every post before it is queued. A post that fails any rule is held back and listed in the weekly email. It is never quietly rewritten.

rules.what: A post linking to anything that earns commission starts with a clear 'Ad' label. 'aff' or 'affiliate' alone is not enough.
Any sowing, planting or harvest month named in a post must match the crop's months in site-data.json. Wherever timing matters the post carries the frost line.
Preserving times, temperatures, acidity and storage figures must appear word for word in the site's preserving text for that crop or recipe. Nothing improvised.
rules.number_pattern: numbers with units: °C, °F, minutes, mins, hours, days, weeks, months, %, ml, litres, g, kg, pH

rules.what: Never show a toxic part as edible. When a post is about a crop the site warns about, it carries the site's own warning sentence.
Every kids' post carries the site's adult-helper note for that project, plus the general 'grown-up says it is safe' rule.
Pest and disease advice only from the site's own pest pages. Any treatment or product named must appear on that page.

If any image or clip is AI-made, the post carries the platform's AI label: Instagram via Buffer's isAiGenerated setting, TikTok via the Chrome task, and a 'Made with AI.' caption line on Facebook (no API field).
rules.policy: brand.json says AI images are never generated, so this should never trigger.

rules.what: No em dashes, no AI words, no 'link in bio', no hashtags on Instagram or Facebook, only links to homegrownplate.co.uk (or a disclosed commission link).
